# Float API Documentation

> Float is resource management software for planning people,
> projects, schedules, and capacity. The Float REST API enables
> developers and AI agents to integrate with Float and
> programmatically access and manage resource planning data.

The Float API uses HTTPS and supports JSON and XML.
API version 3 is available at https://api.float.com/v3.
Authentication requires a bearer token generated in Float.

## Getting Started

- [API Overview](https://developer.float.com/): Introduction, data formats, pagination, and general API usage.

- [Responses](https://developer.float.com/overview_responses.html): Response formats and HTTP status codes.
